title: UG-014 — Overview of translation options in EUSurvey
intent: Summarize the available ways to manage translations.
short_answer: EUSurvey supports translation management through the built-in online translation editor, offline translation by exporting XML/XLS/ODS, DGT translation for EC users, and machine translation.
important_conditions: Finish editing and testing the survey before starting translations.
Translations can be added at any time; it is not necessary to unpublish the survey.
Tick To Publish if the translation should be published with the survey.
